[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/118616108.svg)](https://zenodo.org/badge/latestdoi/118616108)

`babette` is an R package that combines:

- [beautier](https://github.com/ropensci/beautier) creates a BEAST2
  input (`.xml`) file from an inference model
- [tiebeaur](https://github.com/richelbilderbeek/tiebeaur) creates an
  inference model from a BEAST2 input (`.xml`) file ⚠️ experimental ⚠️
- [beastier](https://github.com/ropensci/beastier) runs BEAST2
- [mauricer](https://github.com/ropensci/mauricer) install BEAST2
  packages
- [tracerer](https://github.com/ropensci/tracerer) parses BEAST2 output
  (`.log`, `.trees`, etc) files.

![babette logo](reference/figures/babette_logo.png)

babette logo

Non-CRAN extensions:

- [beastierinstall](https://github.com/richelbilderbeek/beastierinstall)
  Install and uninstall BEAST2
- [mauricerinstall](https://github.com/richelbilderbeek/mauricerinstall)
  Install and uninstall BEAST2 packages

Related R packages:

- [lumier](https://github.com/ropensci/lumier): Shiny app to help create
  the function call needed

Related R functions:

| Related function | `babette` function |
|----|----|
| `[ips::rbeauti](https://github.com/heibl/ips/blob/main/R/rbeauti.R)` | `[beautier::create_beast2_input_from_model](https://github.com/ropensci/beautier/blob/main/R/create_beast2_input_from_model.R)` |

Related software:

- [BEASTifier](https://github.com/josephwb/BEASTifier): command-line
  tool to generate BEAST2 XML input files

## Missing features/unsupported

`babette` cannot do everything `BEAUti` and `BEAST2` and `Tracer` can.

See [beautier](https://github.com/ropensci/beautier) for missing
features in creating a BEAST2 input (`.xml`) file.

See [beastier](https://github.com/ropensci/beastier) for missing
features in running BEAST2

See [mauricer](https://github.com/ropensci/mauricer) for missing
features in installing BEAST2 packages.

See [tracerer](https://github.com/ropensci/tracerer) for missing
features in parsing BEAST2 output (`.log`, `.trees`, etc) files.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bbt_continue()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/bbt_continue.md)
  : Continue a BEAST2 run

- [`bbt_delete_temp_files()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/bbt_delete_temp_files.md)
  : Delete all the temporary files created by bbt_run_from_model

- [`bbt_run()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/bbt_run.md)
  : Run BEAST2

- [`bbt_run_from_model()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/bbt_run_from_model.md)
  : Run BEAST2

- [`bbt_self_test()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/bbt_self_test.md)
  : Do a self test to verify babette that works correctly.

- [`check_beast2_pkgs()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/check_beast2_pkgs.md)
  :

  Checks if `bbt_run` has the 'BEAST2' packages needed to process its
  arguments. Will [stop](https://rdrr.io/r/base/stop.html) if not.

- [`create_test_bbt_run_output()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/create_test_bbt_run_output.md)
  :

  Get an example output of `bbt_run` or `bbt_run_from_model`.

- [`create_test_ns_output()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/create_test_ns_output.md)
  : Create NS testing output

- [`default_params_doc()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/default_params_doc.md)
  : This function does nothing. It is intended to inherit is parameters'
  documentation.

- [`get_alignment_ids_from_xml()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/get_alignment_ids_from_xml.md)
  : Get the alignment IDs from one or more 'BEAST2' XML input files.

- [`get_babette_path()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/get_babette_path.md)
  :

  Get the full path of a file in the `inst/extdata` folder

- [`get_babette_paths()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/get_babette_paths.md)
  :

  Get the full paths of files in the `inst/extdata` folder

- [`is_dropbox_path()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/is_dropbox_path.md)
  : Detect if a path is inside a Dropbox-backed folder

- [`parse_beast2_output()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/parse_beast2_output.md)
  : Process the 'BEAST2' output dependent on 'BEAST2' package specifics

- [`parse_beast2_output_to_ns()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/parse_beast2_output_to_ns.md)
  : Parse BEAST2 NS output

- [`plot_densitree()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/plot_densitree.md)
  : Draw multiple trees on top of one another.

- [`prepare_file_creation()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/prepare_file_creation.md)
  : Internal function to prepare for 'BEAST2' creating files

- [`update_babette()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/update_babette.md)
  : Deprecated function.

- [`warn_if_dropbox()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/babette/reference/warn_if_dropbox.md)
  : Warn when using files in a Dropbox-backed folder
